messages:
Jordan: heads-up — Support flagged the helpdesk article for SSO password resets: the hero image is returning a 403 and the curl example still points at the old v1 endpoint. can someone do a small patch? @Michelle?
Michelle: on it. which page path is that exactly?
Jordan: https://redwood.internal/helpdesk/sso-reset — image path `/_assets/sso-reset.png` 403. curl in the doc: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sso/reset -d '{"email":"user@example.com"}'` — needs to be `v2` and the body shape changed a bit. Support needs this fixed today if possible.
Michelle: ok I can rehost the image to CDN and update the snippet to `https://api.redwood.ai/v2/sso/reset` and adjust the example body. will do a tiny PR (sed + image replace). :thumbsup:
Pranav: quick ask — if you edit it, can you also set frontmatter `owner: helpdesk-team`? I'm swamped but can do a quick CR review.
Michelle: yep will add frontmatter and a one-line changelog entry. tagging @DocBot for preview deploy.
DocBot: starting preview build: docs-preview #1248 for branch `fix/helpdesk-sso-3456` — I'll post results in a min.
DocBot: preview complete — status: passed, 1 warning: image width 2200px (renders large). suggestion: resize to 1200px for consistency.
Jordan: width warning is fine to ignore for now if it saves time. priority is fixing the 403 and snippet.
Michelle: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/3456 — includes image rehost to CDN, snippet update to v2, frontmatter owner bump, tiny changelog. requesting review from @Pranav.
Pranav: quick look — LGTM, left one nit about inline code formatting around the JSON body. once that's fixed i can approve.
Michelle: fixed formatting, pushed. merging now. thanks all. :sparkles:
